## Counties and County Equivalents

```{r New York Counties}
#| code-summary: "Leaflet County Map - NY"
#| code-line-numbers: "1-4|6-7|9-14"

# Download data using our helper function
download_data(
  url = "https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2025/COUNTY/tl_2025_us_county.zip",
  relative_dir = "census/TIGER2025/COUNTY")

# Read Shapefile
census_county  <- read_sf("./data_mid/census/TIGER2025/COUNTY/tl_2025_us_county.shp")

# Plot Leaflet Map
census_county %>%
  filter(STATEFP == "36") %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(weight = 0.5, opacity = 1.0)
```

::: {.notes}

County and county equivalents

The wikipedia page has some good discussion of "County Equivalents" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_United_States_counties_and_county_equivalents
